description: Signed 12x12 multiply-accumulate. Only a[11:0] and b[11:0] are read, both two's complement; a nonzero a[31:12] or b[31:12] is a malformed beat (result=aux=0, fault=1, state kept). The product is added to a 48-bit signed accumulator in state[47:0]; c[31] clears that accumulator before this beat. result=the accumulator clamped to signed 32-bit, and fault=1 whenever that clamp bites. aux[15:0]=accumulator[15:0] and aux[31:16]=accumulator[47:32] keep the untruncated magnitude visible.
hardware_advantage: One multiply and one accumulate retire per enabled beat with no load/store round trip, which is exactly the filter inner loop a CPU must re-fetch every tap.
provenance: original source authored in this workspace; no third-party RTL imported
qualification: engineering candidate; not certified production or side-channel protection
